diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed only the user1-related paths were broken: initial validation showed user1->web1 and user1->app1 failed with 'Network unreachable', while return traffic to user1 failed from 10.255.0.1/10.255.0.3 and all other tested paths were healthy. Read state showed user1 eth1 was down and user1 had no default route; leaf1 already had gateway 10.10.10.1/24 configured on ethernet-1/10. Changed only user1 by bringing eth1 up and adding default route via 10.10.10.1. Final public success criteria validation passed with all connectivity checks succeeding.
diagnosis.reference: On user1, interface eth1 (users_vlan segment) is administratively down (shut down).

arguments.name: ethernet-1/10
arguments.reason: user1 eth1 is down with no default route, and leaf1 ethernet-1/10 is configured with 10.10.10.1/24 but operationally down, isolating the users VLAN while other VLANs are healthy.

commands: ip link set dev eth1 up
ip route add default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1
changes.reason: user1 is one affected endpoint; eth1 is administratively/operationally down and user1 has no default route, while leaf1 provides gateway 10.10.10.1/24 on ethernet-1/10. Other paths are healthy, so repair should be limited to user1.
rollback_commands: ip route del default via 10.10.10.1 dev eth1
ip link set dev eth1 down
